{
  "focus_ref": "29:38",
  "trace_kind": "reconstructed",
  "baseline_models": [
    {
      "model_id": "baseline_ordinary_double_visibility",
      "reading": "ʿĀd and Thamūd are presented as cases already made clear to the addressees through their dwellings. Satan made their intentional deeds appear beautiful and consequently diverted them from the way, although they possessed discernment.",
      "status": "supported",
      "focus_anchor": {
        "quote_ar": "وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ",
        "role": "The complete focus presents both the externally evident case and the internal paradox of attractive deeds, diversion, and continuing discernment."
      },
      "activation_trace": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ب ي ن",
          "source_word_indices": ["4"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000170",
          "branch_id": "B004",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The image of something appearing and becoming clear grounds the addressees' attained clarity."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "س ك ن",
          "source_word_indices": ["7"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000726",
          "branch_id": "B002",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The dwelling and settlement image supplies the material source from which the case is inferred."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ز ي ن",
          "source_word_indices": ["8"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000660",
          "branch_id": "B002",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "Making beauty show distinguishes attractive presentation from inherent goodness."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ش ط ن",
          "source_word_indices": ["10"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000796",
          "branch_id": "B004",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The rebellious, devilish agent supplies the personal source of the deceptive presentation."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ع م ل",
          "source_word_indices": ["11"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_001046",
          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The intentional-doing image makes the beautified objects their own chosen acts."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ص د د",
          "source_word_indices": ["12"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000848",
          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The image covers both blocking another and turning that person aside."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "س ب ل",
          "source_word_indices": ["14"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000672",
          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The extended traversable way supplies the goal from which they were diverted."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ب ص ر",
          "source_word_indices": ["16"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000121",
          "branch_id": "B002",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "Inner sight and verified awareness ground the claim that they were not simply devoid of cognition."
        }
      ],
      "structural_cues": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "quote_ar": "وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ",
          "role": "قَد with the perfect presents clarity as already available, while مِن locates its evidentiary source in the dwellings."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "quote_ar": "وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ",
          "role": "The فـ makes diversion follow beautification, while the final state-clause places discernment beside the failure to follow the way."
        }
      ],
      "mechanism": "The focus contrasts retrospective visibility for the addressees with ineffective insight in the earlier people. Deceptive beautification works by corrupting evaluation, so possession of sight does not itself determine direction.",
      "changed_reading": null,
      "reader_inference": "The packet supplies clarity, dwellings, displayed beauty, intentional work, diversion, a way, and inner sight. No context assumption is needed for this baseline. The reader supplies the ordinary concessive force of the final coordination and reads ٱلسَّبِيلِ as a moral course; a merely coordinative reading and a broader practical route remain grammatically possible. The missing governor of the opening accusatives leaves the exact event involving the two peoples underdetermined in the focus alone.",
      "containment": "Retain this as the ordinary reading without specifying the particular deeds, the psychology or mode of Satanic influence, the precise degree of their insight, or the exact consequence visible in the dwellings."
    }
  ],
  "context_deltas": [
    {
      "model_id": "delta_tested_insight",
      "reading": "The opening trial sequence makes the focus's discernment an ethically unratified capacity: professions and perceptions become truthful only when they govern conduct under pressure, and human affliction can distort the scale by which consequences are judged.",
      "status": "supported",
      "focus_anchor": {
        "quote_ar": "وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ",
        "role": "The final description of discernment is what the earlier testing sequence sharpens."
      },
      "activation_trace": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ب ص ر",
          "source_word_indices": ["16"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000121",
          "branch_id": "B002",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The inner-sight image identifies the cognitive capacity that failed to govern direction."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:2",
          "root": "ف ت ن",
          "source_word_indices": ["10"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_001128",
          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The assaying-by-trial image makes a verbal profession subject to proof."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:3",
          "root": "ص د ق",
          "source_word_indices": ["9"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000852",
          "branch_id": "B004",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The confirmation and fulfillment image presents truth as realized rather than merely claimed."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:10",
          "root": "ف ت ن",
          "source_word_indices": ["12"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_001128",
          "branch_id": "B004",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The ordeal image shows human harm becoming a competing evaluative pressure."
        }
      ],
      "structural_cues": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:2",
          "quote_ar": "أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ",
          "role": "The question denies that saying one believes is sufficient without testing."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:3",
          "quote_ar": "فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ",
          "role": "The paired outcomes distinguish realized truthfulness from false profession."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:10",
          "quote_ar": "فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ",
          "role": "The comparison displays a failure to rank unlike pressures correctly."
        }
      ],
      "mechanism": "The context moves from claimed assent through testing to revealed conduct. That sequence converts the focus's paradox from simple ignorance into insight that has not survived evaluative pressure.",
      "changed_reading": {
        "before": "They possessed insight yet were nevertheless diverted.",
        "after": "They possessed cognition that did not become tested fidelity; the failure lay in how pressure was valued and acted upon, not simply in absence of information."
      },
      "reader_inference": "The packet explicitly supplies profession, testing, truthful realization, falsehood, and the miscomparison of two afflictions. The reader maps that pattern onto مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ. A live alternative is that the focus describes practical or worldly intelligence unrelated to the earlier faith tests.",
      "containment": "Do not erase the focus's positive assertion that they had discernment, and do not treat every hardship as proof of false faith. Present the context as sharpening the knowledge-action gap."
    },
    {
      "model_id": "delta_deeds_need_moral_qualification",
      "reading": "The unqualified أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ is not evil merely because it is called work. Repeated contrasts between works joined to السيئات and works joined to الصالحات show that Satanic beautification is an evaluative misclassification: felt attractiveness can mask the difference between corrupt and sound action.",
      "status": "supported",
      "focus_anchor": {
        "quote_ar": "أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ",
        "role": "The otherwise unqualified noun for their deeds receives moral differentiation from repeated contextual collocations."
      },
      "activation_trace": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ع م ل",
          "source_word_indices": ["11"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_001046",

          "role": "The branch supplies intentional action without building moral value into the noun itself."

          "branch_id": "B002",

          "role": "Making beauty appear explains how apparent value can diverge from actual value."

          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "Badness and ugliness explicitly qualify one class of performed acts."

          "source_word_indices": ["4"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000876",
          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "Soundness against corruption explicitly qualifies the contrasting class of acts."
        }
      ],
      "structural_cues": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:4",
          "quote_ar": "يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ",
          "role": "Work is directly joined to evil acts."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:7",
          "quote_ar": "وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ",
          "role": "The same work vocabulary is directly joined to sound acts."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:7",
          "quote_ar": "أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ",
          "role": "The outcome evaluates performed work by a standard beyond subjective attractiveness."
        }
      ],
      "mechanism": "Repeated qualification controls the focus's bare noun: work is morally open until its alignment is established. Beautification deceives by making one evaluative category look like the other.",
      "changed_reading": {
        "before": "Their deeds as a single block were made attractive.",
        "after": "Their intentional acts were made to appear worthy despite the chapter's explicit distinction between corrupt and sound work; attractiveness is not evidence of soundness."
      },
      "reader_inference": "The packet expressly supplies intentional work and the opposed qualifications السيئات and الصالحات. The reader applies those contrasts to the focus's unqualified noun. A live alternative is that some of أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ denotes worldly projects or customary activities, but the intentional-doing branch still leaves their value to be assessed.",
      "containment": "Do not infer the exact content of their deeds or claim that every attractive act is corrupt. The claim is only that the focus separates attractive presentation from moral quality."
    },
    {
      "model_id": "delta_socialized_diversion_and_burden",
      "reading": "Diversion from the way can be socially voiced: human speakers invite others to follow their own path and offer a false transfer of culpability. The context therefore supplies a human channel for deception while preserving both the follower's liability and an added burden for the misleading party.",
      "status": "supported",
      "focus_anchor": {
        "quote_ar": "فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ",
        "role": "The focus's blocking from the way is re-read through an explicit social invitation to a rival way."
      },
      "activation_trace": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:38",
          "root": "ص د د",
          "source_word_indices": ["12"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000848",
          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The blocking and diversion image supplies the focus-side action."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:12",
          "root": "ت ب ع",
          "source_word_indices": ["6"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000175",
          "branch_id": "B001",

          "role": "Following a person, command, or course supplies the social recruitment mechanism."
        },

          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "Bearing responsibility or sin is the image exploited by the speakers' false promise."

        {

          "source_word_indices": ["9", "14"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000420",
          "branch_id": "B002",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "Culpable wrongdoing is the liability the speakers claim they can transfer."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:13",
          "root": "ث ق ل",
          "source_word_indices": ["2", "3", "5"],
          "mapped_root_id": "root_000202",
          "branch_id": "B001",
          "variant_id": "V001",
          "role": "The repeated heaviness image makes responsibility cumulative rather than removable by rhetoric."
        }
      ],
      "structural_cues": [
        {
          "source_ref": "29:12",
          "quote_ar": "ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ",
          "role": "The imperative joins rival-path recruitment to a promised indemnity."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:12",
          "quote_ar": "وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ",
          "role": "The promise is categorically denied and named false."
        },
        {
          "source_ref": "29:13",
          "quote_ar": "وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًۭا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ",
          "role": "The promised removal is reversed into their own burden plus additional burdens."
        }
      ],
      "mechanism": "A rival way is made appealing through interpersonal speech and an impossible promise that consequences can be outsourced. This concretizes how beautification and blocking may enter a social network.",
      "changed_reading": {
        "before": "Satanic diversion appears as a general, unspecified influence.",
        "after": "The influence can operate through persuasive human invitations and false assurances about responsibility, without turning either guides or followers into consequence-free instruments."
      },
      "reader_inference": "The invitation, false burden claim, and cumulative burdens are packet-supplied. The reader identifies this rhetoric as a possible channel of the focus's Satanic diversion; it could instead be an independent parallel example. Nothing in the packet says that Satan literally uttered the speakers' words.",
      "containment": "Qualify the social mechanism as an activation, not an identification of the speakers with ʿĀd or Thamūd. Do not imply that followers lose their own responsibility or that the additional burdens are exhaustively explained here."
    },
    {

      },

          "branch_id": "B003",

      "structural_cues": [
        {

          "quote_ar": "قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ",
